import random
import itertools
import pandas as pd

# Constants

    "Mercury",
    "Venus",
    "Earth",
    "Mars",
    "Jupiter",
    "Saturn",
    "Uranus",
    "Neptune",
]
ELEMENTS = [
    "Hydrogen",
    "Helium",
    "Oxygen",
    "Carbon",
    "Nitrogen",
    "Magnesium",
    "Silicon",
    "Iron",
    "Nickel",
]

import numpy as np
import random
import itertools
import pandas as pd

# Constants
PLANETS = [
    "Mercury",
    "Venus",
    "Earth",
    "Mars",
    "Jupiter",
    "Saturn",
    "Uranus",
    "Neptune",
]
ELEMENTS = [
    "Hydrogen",
    "Helium",
    "Oxygen",
    "Carbon",
    "Nitrogen",
    "Magnesium",
    "Silicon",
    "Iron",
    "Nickel",
]

def task_func():
    pairs = [f"{planet}:{element}" for planet, element in itertools.product(PLANETS, ELEMENTS)]
    random.shuffle(pairs)

    return pd.DataFrame(
        np.array(pairs, dtype=object).reshape(len(PLANETS), len(ELEMENTS))
    )
